resolution: Resolved the true-vs-rendering question for generated stop signs. The 102 stopSign props exist in the boot state at concrete coordinates, but before the fix the fresh baked gamefile had zero stop-sign pole/face rows. After wiring packageMap through includeGroundLayers, a fresh bake contains 102 red stop-sign face rows and 102 pole rows, including the Wendy Ave targets at x/z 100.5/45.5, 110.5/36.5, and 110.5/45.5.
